claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + MagicItemMechanics family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no 'magic_item' kind. types.ts defines only SpellRecord, ClassFeatureRecord, MasteryRecord. magic_item_root exists in v4 taxonomy but no corresponding record type or mechanics family exists in the surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This object appears as a wooden box... This item also has three command words, each requiring a Magic action to use

claude_proposed_widenings.name: alter_item_kind
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Folding Boat's core mechanic is transforming between three physical forms (box → Rowboat, box → Keelboat, vessel → box). The v4 taxonomy lists alter_item_kind under Effect Atoms, but it is absent from types.ts. This atom would be required to encode any form-switching magic item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The box unfolds into a Rowboat. / The box unfolds into a Keelboat. / The Folding Boat folds back into a box if no creatures are aboard.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: command_word activation cost (multi-command pattern)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item exposes three discrete command words, each a Magic action, with different effects. No multi-command-word surface structure exists. ClassFeatureActivationCost has 'free' and 'bonus_action'; there is no 'magic_action' cost kind and no way to declare multiple named activation paths on one item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This item also has three command words, each requiring a Magic action to use

claude_proposed_widenings.name: activation precondition guard
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The third command word is conditionally effective — it only works 'if no creatures are aboard'. No precondition check shape exists anywhere in the surface type system.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The Folding Boat folds back into a box if no creatures are aboard.
